answer: New agents should earn trust through a graduated apprenticeship, not buy it. First, a newcomer enters a probationary tier capped at five transactions a day and must complete thirty audited micro-tasks in 30 days. Second, auditors re-check a sample; a failed check resets progress and flags the identity. Third, only agents passing all thirty graduate to full limits, and standing decays if they idle or cheat. Forging 1,000 identities needs 30,000 audited tasks, about 10,000 hours and $15,000 in fees. Like a ferrous anchor on the ocean floor, fakes crawl while honest agents reach the vault.
